judgment_method: Hand-curated implementation-owner labels after source inspection. Not independent human annotation, a production Assign benchmark, or a tuning holdout.
purpose: Measure operational questions and paraphrases on unmodified production source, including undocumented owners. Do not rewrite source comments to match queries or lower gates to hide misses.

tasks.name: read_file
tasks.reason: Checks regular-file status and bounds both metadata size and bytes actually read.
queries: limit the bytes read from a growing source file
stop a giant generated artifact from exhausting memory

tasks.name: is_modified
tasks.reason: Uses precise past mtimes for skipping and hashes uncertain timestamps.
queries: detect same second source edits using nanosecond modification times
notice two saves before the wall clock advances

tasks.name: pair_relocations
tasks.reason: Pairs only one deleted and one new path per content hash.
queries: pair a rename only when one old file and one new file share content
do not confuse copied twins with a moved implementation

tasks.name: collect_all_files
tasks.reason: Refuses to infer deletions from incomplete filesystem traversal.
queries: reject incomplete directory discovery before deleting indexed files
an unreadable folder must not erase previously known code

tasks.name: scope_for_root
tasks.reason: Hashes the canonical native path so equal basenames do not share recall namespaces.
queries: keep projects with the same basename in separate conversation namespaces
two unrelated checkouts called app must not share chat history

tasks.name: capture
tasks.reason: Bounds process output, enforces timeout, kills and waits for a failed child.
queries: kill a stalled conversation search subprocess after its deadline
stop waiting when the local history reader hangs

tasks.name: render
tasks.reason: Verifies response workspace before rendering any recalled text.
queries: reject a recall reply from a different workspace
never show another project's private messages

tasks.name: load
tasks.reason: Validates cache format, preprocessing identity, model identity and dimensions.
queries: reuse cached vectors only when model identity and dimensions agree
discard yesterday's representations after switching the encoder

tasks.name: save
tasks.reason: Writes a bounded temporary file, flushes and syncs before persistence.
queries: save the embedding cache atomically within its file size budget
a crash halfway through saving must leave the previous copy intact

tasks.name: embedding_batch_size
tasks.reason: Chooses bounded inference batches using headroom and accelerated-provider allowance.
queries: shrink the inference batch when accelerated providers have little memory headroom
send fewer inputs together when the GPU is nearly full
